audit_items.proof_trace: The bypass at line 1006 (`debt_value <= close_factor_bypass_min_value`) is intentionally per-debt-type (not per-obligation): the `LiquidationParams` struct comment at line 1081 explicitly documents 'the debt being liquidated has usd value less or equal to this value', confirming both the per-type granularity and `<=` semantics. A separate bad-debt bypass (lines 988-992) also allows full liquidation when collateral ≈ debt, but that path is independent of `close_factor_bypass_min_value`.
